intro: This report provides an up-to-date overview of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) product migration to the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE). It details the ingestion status of the extensive CLMS product portfolio, categorising products by global, Pan-European, and priority area. The document summarises product group migration completeness across key CDSE data access services, including S3, OData, STAC, OpenEO, and Sentinel Hub, monitoring CLMS data accessibility and dissemination progress.
